text_blocks.snippet: To avoid spreading COVID-19, the core strategies include staying home when sick, improving ventilation, and wearing a mask in crowded indoor spaces. Additionally, regularly cleaning surfaces, practicing good hygiene like covering coughs and sneezes, and communicating with healthcare professionals are crucial. Consider asking for help with errands to minimize exposure.

list.snippet: If you have symptoms of COVID-19, stay home and away from others to prevent transmission.
This includes avoiding work, school, and social gatherings.
Increase airflow in indoor spaces to dilute the virus concentration.
This can be achieved by opening windows, using fans, or improving ventilation systems.
In crowded indoor settings, a mask can help reduce the spread of respiratory droplets.
Choose a well-fitting mask that covers your nose and mouth.
Cover your coughs and sneezes with a tissue or your elbow.
Regularly wash your hands with soap and water, or use hand sanitizer.
Clean frequently touched surfaces like doorknobs and light switches.
If you test positive for COVID-19, inform people who may have been in close contact with you.
Consider asking friends, family, or neighbors to help with errands to minimize exposure.
Inform healthcare professionals about your positive test result or symptoms if you have an appointment.
